invariants.rationale: The FileHandle used to load the map must not be null to perform further operations such as file.extension().
A non-null fileName is expected to identify the map file to load dependencies from.
The method immediately calls file.extension(), so it must be safe to do so and unlikely to return null.
The extension string should be non-empty for valid map files.
If parameter is provided, it must be an instance of the expected Parameters class.
